segments.text: Africa looks huge on the map. On a money map, it almost vanishes.
Let's redraw the world by the size of each economy.
The USA explodes. It makes about one quarter of all the money on Earth.
China is number two. Together, they make over forty percent.
Japan alone makes more than all of Africa combined.
And giant Russia? Smaller than Italy.
Where does your country land? Tell me in the comments.
